gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.q1: How do I create an account?
gettingStarted.a1: Click "Register" in the top navigation, choose your role (Buyer or Vendor), and fill in your details. You'll receive a confirmation email to verify your account.
gettingStarted.q2: What's the difference between a Buyer and Vendor account?
gettingStarted.a2: Buyers can browse vendors, request quotes, and purchase products. Vendors can create stores, list products, and respond to RFQs.
gettingStarted.q3: How do I switch between Buyer and Vendor roles?
gettingStarted.a3: Contact our support team to request a role change. We'll verify your information and update your account accordingly.

rfq.title: RFQ (Request for Quotation)
rfq.q1: How do I post an RFQ?
rfq.a1: Navigate to the RFQ Board and click "Post RFQ". Fill in the product details, quantity, budget range, and deadline. Vendors will then be able to view and respond to your request.
rfq.q2: Can I save my RFQ as a draft?
rfq.a2: Yes! Your RFQ is automatically saved as a draft as you fill in the form. You can also manually save and return to it later.
rfq.q3: How long do vendors have to respond?
rfq.a3: Vendors can respond until the deadline you set when creating the RFQ. After the deadline, the RFQ status changes to "Expired".

trust.title: Trust & Safety
trust.a1: We verify vendors through business documentation, trade licenses, and quality certifications. Verified vendors display a badge on their profile.
trust.q2: What if I have a dispute with a vendor?
trust.a2: Contact our support team with the details of your dispute. We'll mediate between both parties to reach a fair resolution.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.a1: Shipping terms are negotiated between buyers and vendors. You can specify your preferred destination port and Incoterms when creating an RFQ.
shipping.a2: Tracking details are provided by the vendor once the order is shipped. You can view tracking information in your dashboard.

payments.title: Payments
payments.a1: Payment terms are agreed upon between buyers and vendors. Common methods include bank transfer, letter of credit, and trade assurance.
payments.a2: We offer buyer protection on verified transactions. Contact support for details on our protection policies.

1.content: To access certain features, you must register for an account. 3.content: Vendors must provide accurate product descriptions, pricing, and availability information. Vendors are responsible for fulfilling orders in a timely manner and maintaining the quality standards represented on the platform.

4.title: 5. Buyer Obligations
4.content: Buyers agree to provide accurate information when submitting RFQs and to honor accepted quotations. Buyers must make payments according to agreed-upon terms and communicate promptly with vendors regarding order details.

6.content: B2B Market acts as a platform connecting buyers and vendors. We do not guarantee the quality, safety, or legality of items listed, the accuracy of listings, or the ability of vendors to sell or buyers to pay. We are not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the platform.

7.title: 8. Dispute Resolution
7.content: Any disputes arising from the use of this platform shall first be attempted to be resolved through our internal mediation process. If mediation fails, disputes shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with applicable laws.

8.title: 9. Changes to Terms

0.title: 1. Information We Collect
0.content: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, phone number, and business information during registration. We also collect usage data including pages visited, features used, and interaction patterns to improve our services.

1.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
1.content: We use collected information to provide and maintain our platform, process transactions, communicate with you about services, send promotional materials (with your consent), improve our platform, and comply with legal obligations.

2.title: 3. Information Sharing
2.content: We may share your information with other users as necessary for transactions (e.g., sharing buyer contact information with vendors responding to RFQs). We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

3.title: 4. Data Security
3.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information, including encryption, secure servers, and regular security audits. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

4.title: 5. Cookies & Tracking
4.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, analyze platform usage, and deliver targeted content. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.

5.title: 6. Data Retention
5.content: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. You can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting our support team.

6.title: 7. Your Rights
6.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You can also object to processing, request data portability, and withdraw consent where applicable. Contact us to exercise these rights.

7.title: 8. International Data Transfers
7.content: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your information in compliance with applicable data protection laws.

8.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
8.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.

9.title: 10. Contact Us
9.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at privacy@b2bmarket.com or through our Contact page.
